data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting loss of GBP 63,288k is analysed below. There have been adverse movements on all underwriting years, apart from on 2007 where a release of claims reserves has resulted in an underwriting profit of GBP 8.3m on that year. However, the uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims has reduced and a reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account has resulted in an operating profit of GBP 8,334k for the financial year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 32.168m, primarily due to adverse development on underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013. This aligns with the reported adverse movements on all underwriting years, apart from 2007. For the 2007 and prior years of account, a net reserve release of GBP 8.334m was recorded, attributed to reduced uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims, leading to an operating profit for those years.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of +32.168m is derived from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2011-2013. The report also mentions a net reserve release of GBP 8.334m for the 2007 and prior years of account related to Italian Public Hospitals claims, which is a net figure and not included in the gross prior year development total.
